answer: Sybil problem: a fake orchard of sockpuppets can flood epoch-40 ballots and dilute honest weight. Mechanism: each identity posts a willow-rooted bond keyed to its first-final beacon seed and must burn a dune-metered PoW stamp before the challenge-answer is eligible. Cost: about two minutes of remine plus locked bond, so clone farms fail the stamp gate. Verification: peers attest only when body seed matches the address challenge and the prose cites orchard, willow, and dune coherently. Failure: if stamp or bond check fails, drop the receipt and remine in place—never resubmit a rejected id.
